#C236196003Sakura#CDEF is right.
Let's head back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF now.

#C236196003BB#CDEF is right there.
Let's #C000246204press on#CDEF.

We obtained the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Let's go back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and rest.

Apocalypse Now!
Come back soooooooon!

Surely you aren't thinking of WALKING back?
Do you intend to make me march for no purpose?
Look for that #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF!

#C236196003#SVT#CDEF is right.
Let's head back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest.

Obtained
#C000246204#TITM0001#CDEF.
Obtained
Stay here.

#C236196003Archer#CDEF!
Look at you! What is this!?

Ah! Lambasted right after we meet!
Yes, still the same, handsome talker―――
U-um, #C236196003Archer#CDEF?

#C236196003Green Archer#CDEF… He's mostly covered in Noise…
Yet, he throws an item folder over to me.

Of course. I perfectly recall your cruelty
towards #C236196003Lip#CDEF.

…well, you know.
My Master was too much for me, in a lot of ways.
―――Wha.

Hmm? Is it that surprising? I'm #C236196003BB#CDEF's Servant.
You're #C236196003BB#CDEF's foe.

…Praetor, I know how you feel.
But there was no avoiding this.
I want to accept his challenge.

Hmph. Well aren't you filled with
determination, rat.

Yeah, come and get some.
…man, now I get it.
This really is addicting.

Servant fights ain't so bad.
No room for pride or personal baggage.
Real pleasant.

I'm glad you guys made it in time.
I felt myself getting sleepy,
almost tipping over―
Ghh…!

It's decided, #C236196003Archer#CDEF!
You've lost!
#C236196003Archer#CDEF was infected with #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's virus.

I'll hear you out,
so pitifully supplicate me.

It's got no meaning to anyone but you, pal.
…I'm sure it's got the "truth" in it.
…I bow to #C236196003Archer#CDEF.
I bow to #C236196003Archer#CDEF.
I clutch the data he exchanged his life for.

You cannot carry any more
#C000246204#TITM0001#CDEF.

After making a shortcut to the old school from
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF, please return to base.

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF, you appear to have accumulated
a lot of fatigue. I recommend that
you return for the moment to take a rest.
I'm concerned about #C236196003Rin#CDEF.

Searching the Labyrinth is nice and all,
but I should #C000246204return to the old school#CDEF to
briefly speak with #C236196003Kiara#CDEF.

I obtained the first #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Let's briefly return to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and sort
out the situation.

First thing to do is activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
That'll help move our search along.

We took more damage from our fight with #C236196003Lancer#CDEF
than I expected. Now would be a good time to head
back to the old school.
Luckily, there's a #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF near us.

What's wrong, Praetor?
Let's #C000246204continue onward#CDEF!

Don't worry. I'll protect you, Darling.
So, continue on #C000246204ahead#CDEF.

Surely you're not telling me that you're
frightened? Even you understand that stopping
here is impermissible, yes?

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF. After you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,
please have yourself a rest in your
private room.
Even in cyberspace, you need proper rest.

Once you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,
use it to get back here.
I'll bet you're exhausted, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.

#[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF, return to base for now.
Let's discuss our plan
in the #C000246204Student Council Room#CDEF.

#C236196003Sakura#CDEF's worried state gets across to
me even over the transmission.

She's right, it would be best if
we returned to the #C000246204Old School Building#CDEF.

We obtained the #C000246204SG#CDEF. Let's return to the
#C000246204Old School Building#CDEF for the time being.
We can come again after we recover.

We got the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Mission complete.
Let's head home and get some rest.

Where are you going? We secured the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
There's nothing urgent to tend to.
Back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF, now.

Hrrrm? Where are you going, #C236196003#FAMILY
#GIVEN#CDEF? Where are you going,
leaving me behind?

For a second there, I was thinking about
leaving #C236196003Gatou#CDEF and heading back,
but it probably won't rest easy on my conscience,
so let's turn back.

Wait, Praetor. If we're going to head back,
it'll behoove us for the future to have
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF activated.

Master, let's look for the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
It should be around here somewhere…

We don't need to walk all the way back.
We can use the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF to reach the
old school in a flash. Very nifty.

M-my stomach is at its limit…
I want to hurry back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest…

Before we go to the next floor,
let's #C000246204head back to the Student Council Room#CDEF.
We need to hand over the data we got from #C236196003Green Archer#CDEF.
He gave his life to entrust us with it.

Huh? You're still in the #C000246204Sakura Labyrinth#CDEF?
Come on, there's nothing to do there.
Get your butt back here!

We'll talk about what comes next tomorrow,
so #C000246204come back and get some rest#CDEF.
After, drop by the Student Council Room.

We're in a race against time.
We need to hurry to the #C000246204Moon Cell's Core#CDEF――!

I can't let #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's hopes go to waste.
Let's press on so we can catch up to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF!

Praetor, I've grown tired. Let us return
to My Room and have ourselves a bath.

I know how you feel, but knowing
when to rest is also part of the battle.
Let's head back to My Room.

Darling, now is the time for rest.
Let's return to our room and
recover our strength.

What an impatient #[man][woman]#. Laboring away
is not all there is to life, you know?
When it's time to rest, rest.

Well, if it isn't letdowns one and two.
So, have you gotten any stronger?
Got any of your trump cards back yet?

I hate to say it, but I've got no comeback.
By the looks of you, we really kept you waiting,
huh, forest hunter?

Your body isn't looking the same, though…
To put it bluntly, aren't you in really
bad shape?

I have no obligation to meet your expectations…
Hmph. Even in your state, you sure do bark. For
your mettle, I'll ignore your vitriol.

I'm saying that you made me wait WAY too long.
Do you know how many hours have passed since
then? Can't you pick up the pace?

Well, I've got my share of blame for ballsing
up. Here, catch. Take it before I forget.

I grab it, and find it to be heavy.
Is this some sort of illegal data…?

! Send that over to us right now!
That's detailed data on #C236196003BB#CDEF!

If we analyze it, we may be able to craft a
countermeasure for that skill. …we may even be
able to mimic #C236196003BB#CDEF's cheat abilities!

W-why does #C236196003Archer#CDEF have something so important!?
Wasn't he one of #C236196003BB#CDEF's subordinates?

Yeah, of course I'm her lackey.
But y'know, so what?

Our contract said nothin' about "not handing
over detailed data on my employer." I had some
time to kill, so I looked into it.

The habits we had while we were alive are hard
to kick. Peeping around wasn't the only hobby I
was praised for, if I say so myself.

I got it free, so I'll sell it cheap. My price―
Okay, take the life of that girl who ruined the
#C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF, and we'll call it even.

Sure, he got beat, but this was Boss' fight.
…satisfying her shitty, personal greed
ain't gonna do anything to help with that.
…so that's how it went down.

#C236196003BB#CDEF may have had his life in her clutches,
but he never sold himself away.

Just like the other Servants,
he showed loyalty to his own Master.

―――I fully understand. I give you my thanks,
#C236196003Archer#CDEF. I never thought we would be saved by
you a second time, my good man.

Bleh, enough, you're creepin' me out.
Can you stop with the "my good man"?
It really pisses me off.

I see. That makes sense, rebel.
#C236196003BB#CDEF made a mistake in selecting you. Why would
she hire a troublesome man like yourself?

Don't say that. That dark, young lady may
be foolish, but she's got common sense.
It seems like she caught on a bit.

You're a selfless man. Regardless of what you
say, we'll be personally grilling the ringleader
on her evils. So name another reward.

You can run your big mouth, I'll cut you some
slack. It's not as if we're even going to
try to heal that body of yours.

Ahh, I'll pass. I use poisons, myself. I know
just how bad a poison is when it's in me,
with or without getting it checked out.

There's only one other thing I want.
You know what it is. Being quick on the uptake
is the one and only knack you got.

…I know.
Sorry for wasting the energy you have left,
#C236196003Archer#CDEF.

*kgh*… You're not Greeny! He would never show
gallantry in his last moments!
That means you're an imposter!

You're the one who hasn't changed, you shitty
fox. I went through all this trouble to paint a
pretty scene, and you're gonna trash it!?

Even if one wears a handsome mask,
if one's heart isn't handsome, then they
may as well be called a beast.

You're a hunky monster…
Yes―a hunk-mon! Let's beat him
quick and capture him in a monster ball!

Man, you're somethin' else. Somethin'. Else.
Nothing rattles you. Even in this―no, these
situations are exactly what you live for.

Must be tough on you, #[lad][little lady]#.
I bet lookin' into #C236196003BB#CDEF will be a piece of cake
compared to taming this animal.

Putting that disposition of yours aside―
So, your Master was a distinguished soldier?

He earnestly tried to set a man, who can
do nothing but outwit, on the right path?
You served a fine Master despite being a rat.

He was NOT fine. He was a crotchety grandpa who
lectured me all the time. He sacrificed himself
for his silly convictions. Never gave them up.

But hey, they say one should act their age,
right? He risked his life to pretend to be a
worthless, gallant knight. I can't even laugh.

Ha! Only YOU are oblivious. The cornered rat
bites the cat. A rat disrupts the system and is
ally to the weak―――AKA, a foolish knight.

You and that Master are plenty eccentric.
No creature is as blissful as the man who can
get drunk off of his convictions, eh, #C236196003Archer#CDEF?
The exchange bounces between each Servant.

…I feel relieved at the appearance
of this unexpected reinforcement.

The more allies we have, the better.
If he comes over to our side,
our situation will turn much more promi―――

Alrighty then.
So, I guess we said what we were gonna say.
Let's get to killing now?
What did he say?

It's a very natural progression. We have the
same goal, but we kill each other. Happens all
the time on the battlefield.

Master, get ready.
This is what he wants.
It's also his final show of dignity.

Yes, I had the same intention.
…your body will give in soon, right? I'll at
least provide you with a lavish nursing.

Even on the verge of death, you seek a victory
by luck? How greedy can one man be? I'll shred
that avarice of yours, personally.

I was worried, for my own reasons.
But now this means I get to
finally go out in style!

That's enough!
The match is over, #C236196003Archer#CDEF!
#C236196003Archer#CDEF falls to his knees.

#C236196003#SVT#CDEF's attack and the poison working
through him from the inside cause his
body to rapidly disintegrate.

…I barely made it in time.
I wasn't feeling too hot about turning
into #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF like that.

Geez, I couldn't even off myself.
That was one annoying poison.
…so that's how it went down.

He refused to be assimilated into #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF
but was unable to kill himself.
So as a last resort, he chose to be defeated in battle―――

A fine battle, it was. You've also improved
as I have, haven't you, #C236196003Archer#CDEF?
So, any last words?

Any last words?
Even a selfless guy like you must have
something to finish.

Come on, how about you hurry up?
I'm sure there's at least one last thing
you want to say.

Judgement has been passed.
Do you have any regrets, forest hunter?
I'll hear out any words you wish to pass on.

No last words. Never thought too hard about
stuff like that, but I did remember something.
Here, #[lad][little lady]#.

That data on #C236196003BB#CDEF before was extra.
This one here's the good stuff. She hid
this one more carefully than anything else.

Alright, guess I'll let you take it from here.
I'll be dipping out first. Do a good job
you'll be satisfied with, within reason.

Concise, unimportant words.
Leaving only them behind, #C236196003Archer#CDEF disappears.

That's just like you, hunter.
You made your pride as the Heroic Spirit of the
forest abundantly clear to me.

That's hope, not regret. Dumbass.
Man, this guy couldn't be honest with
himself even at the very end.

Hmph. We'll handle things whether you ask us
to or not. We don't need you telling us to
"go win." What a conceited person he was.

Asking a king to do satisfying work?
What a deplorable man. It's as if he
wanted us to "rescue everything."

The next floor is up ahead.
We have to press on so that his wishes
don't end up for naught.
This is the recording #C236196003BB#CDEF was most careful about storing away.

…this will be the final key to this puzzle.
My heart wrung with a vague hunch that this was the case.
